Boom’s Pizza Sauce Heating SOP

  1. Portion sauce: 1570 g Boom’s Pizza Sauce [BOOM 0002]. Place the sauce in a 4-inch deep, quarter hotel pan.
  2. Heat in oven: Place the uncovered hotel pan on a pizza rack in the oven. 10–12 minutes.
  3. Verify temperature: Heat until the sauce reaches 165°F for a minimum of 40 seconds.
  4. Transfer to service well: Immediately transfer the sauce to the service well for hot holding.
  5. Add salt and stir: 6 g Kosher Salt. Add the salt to the sauce and stir thoroughly with the ladle until fully incorporated.
  6. Quality check: Spot check for quality by tasting with a clean tasting spoon.
  7. Hot hold during service: Keep the sauce at above 140°F throughout service.

Food Safety Reminder

Cook temp: 165°F for a minimum of 40 seconds. Hot hold temp: above 140°F throughout service.
